definitions.name: U3A.COUNT
definitions.note: Vector of truth values -> how many are TRUE

definitions.name: U3A.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'U3A.DN' BIND 1 U3A.DN RANGE [ 'U3A.D' BIND U3A.DN U3A.D DIV FLOOR U3A.D MUL U3A.DN EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer N -> ascending Vector of its positive divisors

definitions.name: U3A.RED6
definitions.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
definitions.note: bracket String (up to 12 chars) -> fixpoint after repeatedly deleting adjacent () and [] pairs

definitions.name: U3A.REVENUE
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'U3A.O' BIND U3A.O 'price' GET 'U3A.PP' BIND 0 U3A.PP U3A.PP NIL? SELECT U3A.O 'qty' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total of qty*price over orders with a price (missing price counts 0)

definitions.name: U3A.QTYREC
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'U3A.OS' BIND U3A.OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP U3A.OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'U3A.G' BIND U3A.G KEYS U3A.G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty, skus in first-appearance order

solutions.runs.rle: G0D.RUNS [ 'U3A.R' BIND U3A.R 0 GET U3A.R LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'U3A.V' BIND U3A.V U3A.V G0D.SHIFT GT 0 [ 'U3A.B' BIND 'U3A.A' BIND U3A.A 1 ADD 1 U3A.B SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.majority: 'U3A.V' BIND U3A.V TALLY 'U3A.T' BIND U3A.T U1D.TOPKEY 'U3A.K' BIND U3A.K NIL U3A.T U3A.K GET 2 MUL U3A.V LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.number.primes: 'U3A.N' BIND 1 U3A.N RANGE [ U3A.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
solutions.number.binary: 'U3A.N' BIND [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] [ U3A.N GT NOT ] FILTER 'U3A.P' BIND U3A.N U3A.P DIV FLOOR 'U3A.Q' BIND U3A.Q U3A.Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB STR JOIN
solutions.number.collatz: 'U3A.N' BIND 1 150 RANGE U3A.N [ 'U3A.I' BIND 'U3A.C' BIND 1 U3A.C 2 DIV U3A.C 3 MUL 1 ADD U3A.C 2 DIV FLOOR U3A.C 2 DIV EQ SELECT U3A.C 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN 'U3A.SQ' BIND U3A.N 1 COLLECT U3A.SQ CONCAT [ 1 GT ] FILTER LENGTH
solutions.number.digital_root: 1 SUB 'U3A.M' BIND U3A.M U3A.M 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD
solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ 'U3A.CH' BIND [ '(' ')' '[' ']' ] [ 1 -1 1 -1 ] RECORD U3A.CH GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS 'U3A.CS' BIND 0 U3A.CS LENGTH RANGE [ 'U3A.K' BIND U3A.CS U3A.K TAKE JOIN U3A.RED6 '' EQ ] FILTER -1 GET
solutions.sensor.present_mean: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'U3A.P' BIND U3A.P 0 [ ADD ] FOLD U3A.P LENGTH DIV
solutions.sensor.filled: 'U3A.V' BIND U3A.V U3A.V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'U3A.E' BIND 'U3A.A' BIND U3A.A U3A.E U3A.E NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP 'U3A.M' BIND FALSE 1 COLLECT U3A.M -1 DROP CONCAT NOT U3A.M AND U3A.COUNT
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ NIL? ] MAP 0 [ 'U3A.B' BIND 'U3A.A' BIND U3A.A 1 ADD 0 U3A.B SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'U3A.V' BIND U3A.V [ NIL? ] MAP 'U3A.M' BIND 1 U3A.V U3A.M SELECT 'U3A.W' BIND U3A.W 1 DROP U3A.W -1 DROP DIV NIL U3A.M 1 DROP NOT U3A.M -1 DROP NOT AND SELECT
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'U3A.V' BIND U3A.V [ NIL? ] MAP 'U3A.M' BIND U3A.V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER SORT -1 GET 'U3A.X' BIND 1 U3A.V U3A.M SELECT U3A.X DIV NIL U3A.M NOT SELECT
solutions.orders.unpriced: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.messy.title: G0D.WORDS [ CHARS 'U3A.WC' BIND U3A.WC 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER U3A.WC 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP G0A.UNWORDS
